title: API database password typo
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the API deployment as the broken part, the problem as a faulty deploy introducing bad credentials, and the trigger as the deployment itself.
root_cause: The API deployment 45 minutes ago (shopapp/api:2.3.2) introduced incorrect database credentials, causing password authentication failures for user "shop" and resulting in 500/503 errors on product endpoints and health checks.
truth: api 2.3.2 was deployed with a typo in the DATABASE_PASSWORD environment variable, so the application cannot authenticate to PostgreSQL.
